name: reanimate
hook: New skill that reverse-engineers any animation — live URL, MP4, GIF, screen recording, or Lottie — and rebuilds it in your stack. The 5-step loop records the original, writes a per-element timing-and-easing spec, builds with CSS/Framer Motion/GSAP/three.js, compares frame-by-frame (reports pixel mismatch and diff images), and repeats until match. Add `--gl` for WebGL/WebGPU/Canvas capture including shaders and three.js scene graphs.

name: Stitch Skills (Google Labs)
hook: Official Google Labs skill pack bridging Stitch and Claude Code across a full design-to-code loop. 15 skills in 3 plugins: stitch-design converts code to screens and extracts DESIGN.md tokens; stitch-build converts Stitch screens to React, React Native, or React+Vite (with Remotion walkthrough video option); stitch-utilities generates DESIGN.md, enhances vague UI prompts, and builds multi-page sites from one prompt. Requires Stitch MCP server. ~8.7k stars.
install: npx plugins add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --scope project --target claude-code

name: Skills For Real Engineers (mattpocock)
hook: Matt Pocock's (TypeScript Total TypeScript) 27-skill pack for engineers who want engineering discipline, not vibe coding. The 20 engineering skills include /tdd (red-green-refactor loop), /diagnosing-bugs (phase-gated), /to-spec, /code-review, and /improve-codebase-architecture. The 7 productivity skills include /grill-me — a full branch-tree interview before work starts — and a GLOSSARY.md shared vocabulary that reduces agent verbosity. Run /setup-matt-pocock-skills once per repo.

name: Cuttlefish.MD (HackerNoon)
hook: HackerNoon's Project Cuttlefish.MD packages 2,806 license-checked skills from 29 authors into 9 category plugins for Claude Code. Categories: Dev Workflow (530 skills), Data & Science (599), QA & Testing (422), Marketing & SEO (307), Writing & Blogging (706), Design & UI (131), Security (102), HackerNoon Originals (1), Learn Tech (8). Every skill is credited to its author with its license verified. Featured on TechBeat today (Nov 16).

name: last30days-skill
hook: Research skill that queries 30+ sources in parallel (Reddit, HN, YouTube, X, Polymarket, GitHub, arXiv, Bluesky, DEV.to, Techmeme, Yahoo Finance, LinkedIn, Threads, TikTok, local files, and more) and ranks results by engagement — upvotes, views, prediction-market volume — not SEO. Zero-config for Reddit, HN, Polymarket, and GitHub; a setup wizard unlocks the rest. v3.31.0, 63k+ stars.

name: Claude Code v2.1.319
hook: Nov 6 release adds two impactful workflow features. First: MCP task calls now move to the background immediately — Claude Code notifies you when they finish instead of blocking the session (disable with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS=1). Second: new `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting` setting silently denies disallowed tool calls rather than waiting for a human to dismiss the prompt — essential for unattended runs. `npm latest` and `next` tags now point to this version.

name: Claude-BugHunter (elementalsouls)
hook: Authorized bug-bounty and red-team skill bundle: 83 skills, 15 slash commands (Claude Code only), grounded in 681 disclosed HackerOne report patterns. Coverage: 58 web-app skills (XSS, SQLi, SSRF, IDOR, SSTI), 10 enterprise-platform skills (M365/Entra, Okta, vCenter, SSL VPN), 6 reporting/validation, 5 recon/OSINT, 4 methodology. Works across Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Hermes Agent, and AntiGravity. For authorized targets only.

name: Claude Code Game Studios
hook: Template that turns a Claude Code session into a 49-agent game-development studio with 75 skills, 15 event hooks, 62 document templates, and four engine tracks (Web/default, Godot 4, Unity, UE5). Brief-first workflow: Claude asks genre-tailored questions, you approve a one-page brief, then a headless browser runs scripted play-checks (startup errors, unresponsive controls, layout problems) after each build. `modes.rigor` (minimal/standard/full) controls documentation overhead.
install: git clone https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios.git my-game && cd my-game && claude
